label: early original-phase steps at or just after p/q inputs
explanation: Fires only during the original input phase, mostly at t=2-5 (t=2-4 hold ~88% of mass). Never fires at t=0, at the delimiter, or in the copy phase. Strongest when the input is p or q (rate ~6%, 6.4x lift) or the previous input was p (8x). Repeats like p p / p q give the top activations (~0.3). Activation then decays over the next 1-3 steps. Weaker lift from u, 1, g, y, b, f, j. Diffuse overall: the best predicate has dev precision ~0.20, recall ~0.44, mass recall ~0.57. Many steps after p/q stay inactive, and much of the mass sits on weaker, varied tokens.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=1: p, q, 1, u; t=5: q, p, u, 1; t=6: p, q, u, y) and the previous input (most: p, q, 1, y, f, j; least: d, w, l, i); timing cues that raise it most: t=3, t=2, t=4.
